Every detector candidate remains exactly one heel sphere plus one forefoot sphere.
All candidates are evaluated directly at both 10 ms and 1 ms on the already-open development block 50 <= t < 100 s.

A PASS remains development evidence only and cannot create or promote a detector profile.
The sealed block remains closed, and no policy, training, rollout, runtime default, FSM, or active profile is modified.
The runtime RL load-routing gap remains unresolved, so a development winner is not deployable or promotable.
objective: Repeat the unchanged V6 two-sensor multiresolution geometry screen after adding the single inherited gate dictionary omitted by the V6 harness. No geometry, threshold, FSM, sampling, evidence-routing, ranking, or scientific gate change is allowed.
